description: A cloud POS guest check in the layout cloud systems such as Foodics print in text mode: 'Order #' and 'Dine In' on one row, Qty / Item / Amount columns, indented '+' modifiers (priced or not) under their item, a VAT line added on top, the total in double size with a second total in LBP. Modelled on typical layouts; not yet checked against a real capture.
